intended_object: This is a hard-coded array of (index, 64-bit summary) pairs. Together with the other groups it makes up a computational coverage certificate for the Erdős #97 convex-octagon case analysis. This reading comes from the docstring "Shallow HardSummary group 5" and the module name, CoverageCertificateSummaries.
explanation: The definition is a table of literal certificate data: encoded bitmask summaries for cases 1032–1095. It exists only to support a decidable or computational check inside the library's proof. It has no counterpart in the mathematical literature, so it is an implementation detail rather than a mathematical object.
